commentary.text: 90+10' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+9' A pass by Jose Angel Carmona (Getafe) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ath Bilbao.
90+9' Jose Angel Carmona (Getafe) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
90+7' Ath Bilbao take a short corner kick.
90+6' The linesman raises his flag. Jeremy Jorge (Getafe) is adjudged offside.
90+4' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) times his leap well to meet the lofted pass from Jose Angel Carmona, but his close-range header slips just over the bar.
90+1' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Oscar Rodriguez (Getafe) takes it short.
90' The fourth official shows 9 min. of added time.
89' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jeremy Jorge (Getafe) is coming onto the pitch as Jaime Mata cannot continue after picking up an injury.
89' Here is a change. Nemanja Maksimovic is going off and Jose Bordalas Jimenez gives the last tactical orders to Carles Alena (Getafe).
89' A cross is whipped into the centre of the box towards Nemanja Maksimovic (Getafe). He gets a good contact on the ball but heads it high over the bar.
89' Getafe have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

88' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) fails to beat the goalkeeper from the penalty spot with a shot into the bottom left corner. Unai Simon anticipates his intention perfectly, though, and leaps to stop his effort. The ball is out of play. Getafe will have a chance to score from a corner.
88' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
88' Referee Jesus Gil Manzano is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Getafe!
86' Celebrations by Getafe are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.
85' The match ends for Ernesto Valverde Tejedor (Ath Bilbao) as he received a red card.
85' Getafe are given a huge opportunity to score - it's a penalty kick!
84' A quickly taken corner by Getafe.
84' Omar Alderete (Getafe) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Getafe earn a corner.
83' CHANCE! Oscar Rodriguez (Getafe) goes very close! He gathers a cross inside the box and fires a sublime shot to the left side of the goal, but Unai Simon produces an excellent save.
82' We are about to witness a substitution. Imanol Garcia de Albeniz (Ath Bilbao) is replacing Inaki Williams.
82' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor prepares a substitution. Nico Williams is replaced by Raul Garcia (Ath Bilbao).
81' Luis Milla (Getafe) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar.
80' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) latches on to a precise cross and hammers the ball goalwards, but it flies just wide of the left post.
80' Juanmi Latasa (Getafe) rises above the defence and heads a precise cross towards the left post. His effort, however, is blocked by Unai Simon, who pulls off a stunning save!

79' Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao) must have known he would be sent off for this foul, but he had to stop the opponent at all costs. Jesus Gil Manzano shows him a second yellow card and the game has ended for him.
78' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) sends a superb lead pass into the penalty area and finds Inaki Williams, who fails to shoot.

77' Nemanja Maksimovic (Getafe) is first to the cross from Fabrizio Angileri, but fires his header just past the left post from close range. The ball goes out of play and Ath Bilbao will have a goal kick.
76' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor has decided to make a change. Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) replaces Unai Gomez.
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Dani Garcia (Ath Bilbao) replaces Ander Herrera.
75' The defence just can't clear the ball and a rebound eventually falls to Mason Greenwood (Getafe) deep inside the box, but his well-hit shot flies just wide of the right post.
75' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) works the corner short.

74' A poor mid-range free-kick by Oscar Rodriguez (Getafe) is easily blocked by the defensive wall. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Getafe will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
74' The attendance for today's match is 12149.
74' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Diego Rico as he is replaced by Fabrizio Angileri (Getafe).
73' Getafe take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

73' A huge opportunity wasted! Oscar Rodriguez (Getafe) produces a header from a rebound inside the six-yard box. His effort is denied by one of the defenders who is well positioned and clears the ball to safety. Getafe have been awarded a corner kick.
72' Yellow card. Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.

72' That didn't go as planned! Oscar Rodriguez (Getafe) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the right side of the goal was too weak to get past Unai Simon, who easily kept it out.
70' Omar Alderete (Getafe) strikes a first-time volley towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but his effort is way off target and the ball goes well wide of the right post.
68' Mason Greenwood crosses and Nemanja Maksimovic (Getafe) misses a great opportunity with his head from close in, sending the ball just wide of the right post.
67' Getafe take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

66' Some great play by Mason Greenwood (Getafe) ends with a shot on the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Unai Simon sees it all the way and makes a comfortable save. Getafe force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
66' Luis Milla (Getafe) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

65' Juanmi Latasa (Getafe) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Corner kick. Getafe will have an opportunity.
64' One of the Getafe players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
62' Mason Greenwood plays a pass into the path of Oscar Rodriguez (Getafe), who shoots way too fast from mid-range and sends the ball miles over the bar.
62' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao) replacing Alex Berenguer.
61' Juanmi Latasa (Getafe) misses a sitter from inside the six-yard box after striking the ball narrowly wide of the goal.
59' A substitution has been made. Ilaix Moriba goes off and Juanmi Latasa (Getafe) comes on.
58' Yeray Alvarez (Ath Bilbao) is really surprised after seeing a red card for his tackle. That's a harsh decision.
57' The corner from Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) is intercepted by the defence.
57' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Ath Bilbao, is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Ath Bilbao.
56' Jesus Gil Manzano blows his whistle for a foul after Luis Milla (Getafe) hacks down one of his opponents.
55' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) takes the corner.
54' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) passes the ball onto Inaki Williams, but one of the defenders dispossesses him. Ath Bilbao will take a corner kick.
54' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
53' PENALTY APPEAL by Getafe, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!

51' 0 - 2 Superb finishing from Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao). Nico Williams plays a fantastic through ball and finds Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao), who reacts quickly to get in front of the goal and fire a low shot from close range past the goalkeeper. It's 0:2.
50' Oscar Rodriguez (Getafe) unleashes a decent shot towards goal from long range, but his effort just misses the target. The ball goes out of play and Ath Bilbao will have a goal kick.
49' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty as the referee indicates there was no infringement.
49' Referee Jesus Gil Manzano makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
49' Surely that's handball by one of the Ath Bilbao players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!

48' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) wasted a huge opportunity! The fans already began to celebrate as he produced a shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball went towards the left side of the goal, but Unai Simon made an astonishing save!
48' Luis Milla (Getafe) is penalised for holding. Jesus Gil Manzano signals a set piece.
47' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Jose Angel Carmona (Getafe).
47' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Getafe for a penalty. Play continues.
46' Rough tackle by Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Alex Berenguer, but David Soria displays great awareness to stop him.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
42' The linesman signals that Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
41' Yeray Alvarez (Ath Bilbao) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
41' Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
39' Jesus Gil Manzano blows his whistle and signals a foul after Ilaix Moriba (Getafe) brought his opponent down.
36' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
33' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) latches on to a cross on the edge of the box and fires a shot at goal, but his effort was blocked by one of the defenders.
31' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

30' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) wasted a huge opportunity! The fans already began to celebrate as he unleashed a powerful shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball went towards the bottom right corner, but Unai Simon made a crucial save! The ball is out of play and Getafe manage to earn a corner.
29' Jaime Mata (Getafe) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
27' 0 - 1 Goal! Nico Williams tees up Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) on the edge of the box and he fires the ball into the bottom right corner. 0:1.
27' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
26' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) meets a cross just outside the area and gets in a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
23' Good defending. Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) tries to find Alex Berenguer inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
22' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) whips in a cross from the corner, but Unai Simon is well positioned and punches the ball away.
22' Getafe force a corner. They send men into the box. Mason Greenwood (Getafe) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
22' That's unlucky! Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
19' Yeray Alvarez (Ath Bilbao) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
18' Yeray Alvarez (Ath Bilbao) picks up an injury.
18' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) attempts to find Inaki Williams, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Getafe.
16' A cross into the box from Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) is cleared.
16' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
16' The ball is cleared after Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
15' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Jaime Mata (Getafe) heads on.
12' Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
9' It looks like Diego Rico (Getafe) saw red with that tackle. Jesus Gil Manzano won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
7' The ball rebounds to Ilaix Moriba (Getafe) inside the box after a goalmouth scramble, but he whips the ball high over bar.
6' Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Jesus Gil Manzano saw the whole situation.
5' Getafe keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
3' The resulting corner from Mason Greenwood (Getafe) is cleared by the defence.

2' Diego Rico (Getafe) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
1' The first half has just begun.
Ath Bilbao will kick-off.
Jesus Gil Manzano will officiate today.
